levels.title: Roll, Berry, Roll!
levels.goalText: Help the berry roll down into Lory's bowl!
levels.hintText: Ooh! A slanty plank under the ledge makes a slide all the way to my bowl!

levels.title: Boing!
levels.goalText: Bounce the berry way up into the bowl on the shelf!
levels.teaches: trampoline (bounces a falling ball back up)
levels.hintText: Put the trampoline right where the berry lands — the bigger the fall, the bigger the BOING!

levels.title: Domino Parade
levels.goalText: Fix the domino line so the last one dings the bell!
levels.teaches: domino (chains topple if spaced close together)
levels.hintText: Two dominoes are missing from the parade! Stand them in the gap, nice and close.

levels.title: Berry Express
levels.goalText: Give the berry a moving-belt ride over the little wall!
levels.hintText: Catch the falling berry on a belt pointing right — all aboard the Berry Express!

levels.title: Whoosh!
levels.goalText: Blow the beach ball off the shelf so it plops onto the bell!
levels.teaches: fan (wind pushes light things like beach balls)
levels.hintText: Beach balls love a breeze! Set the fan on the shelf, blowing toward the edge.

levels.title: Pop Goes Bloopy
levels.goalText: Steer Bloopy the balloon into the spiky pokers — POP!
levels.teaches: balloons float up; fans steer them sideways
levels.hintText: Bloopy only floats straight up. A fan blowing right will scoot him under the pokers!

levels.title: Pinball Berry
levels.goalText: Bounce the berry off the bumper and up into the bowl on the tower!
levels.hintText: Bumpers bounce like crazy! Put one right under the falling berry and watch it fly.

levels.title: Marble Kaboom
levels.goalText: Drop the heavy marble on the seesaw and fling the berry up to the bell!
levels.teaches: marble + seesaw (heavy on one end flings light on the other)
levels.hintText: Hold the marble WAY up high over the empty end of the seesaw. One... two... KABOOM!

levels.title: The Big Push
levels.goalText: Finish the domino line so the berry gets pushed off, then slide it into the bowl!
levels.teaches: combo: marble starter + domino chain + plank ramp
levels.hintText: Fill the domino gap, then build a slide under the ledge so the berry has somewhere to land!

levels.title: Over the Wall
levels.goalText: Bounce the berry OVER the big wall, then slide it into the bowl!
levels.teaches: combo: trampoline arc + plank landing ramp
levels.hintText: Trampoline BEFORE the wall to jump it, plank AFTER the wall to catch the landing. Ta-da!

levels.title: Double Bubble Pop
levels.goalText: Blow BOTH balloons into the middle so they pop on the pokers!
levels.teaches: two fans at once; funnel planks guide floaty things
levels.hintText: One fan blows right, one blows left — the slanty boards will funnel the balloons to the pokers!

levels.title: Fling It Over
levels.goalText: Send the marble riding to the seesaw and fling the berry over the fence into the bowl!
levels.teaches: combo: marble delivery by conveyor + seesaw catapult
levels.hintText: Marble on the slanty shelf, belt pointing right — it needs to drop on the FAR end of the seesaw!

levels.title: Sky Ding
levels.goalText: Slide the berry onto the trampoline and launch it clear across to the bell!
levels.teaches: aiming long trampoline arcs with a ramp for speed
levels.hintText: A slanty plank makes the berry FAST, and a fast berry bounces far. Aim for the sky bell!

levels.title: Lory's Grand Machine
levels.goalText: Start the whole machine: ball, bridge, dominoes, marble, seesaw... berry in the bowl!
levels.teaches: grand finale: full chain reaction with everything you learned
levels.hintText: Beach ball at the tippy-top, a bridge to the big table, and NO gaps in the dominoes. Then just press PLAY and enjoy the show!

notes:
CONVENTIONS: All x,y are object CENTERS. Angles are degrees, clockwise-positive: a positive angle tips the RIGHT end DOWN (ball rolls right); negative tips the LEFT end down. Dominoes on a surface sit at centerY = surfaceTop - 28; berry at surfaceTop - 16; marble at -18; beach ball at -28; fan at -28; bell resting at -30. Bowls on the floor sit at y=655; bowls on shelves at shelfTop - 42 (approx).

DIFFICULTY ARC: Levels 1-8 each teach ONE idea with an almost-finished diorama and a single obvious gap (plank, trampoline, domino, conveyor, fan, balloon+spikes, bumper, marble+seesaw). Levels 9-14 combine 2-3 ideas with longer, watchable chains. Goal mix: 8 catch, 4 bell, 2 pop.

ROBUSTNESS NOTES FOR VERIFICATION:
- L1/L4/L7/L10: launch shelves are tilted 6-14 deg so the berry self-starts at PLAY; falls before player parts are kept under ~250px and targets (plank 160 wide, trampoline 110, bowl rim 130) give roughly +/-40px placement slack.
- L3/L9/L14 domino gaps are exactly 40px pitch matching the fixed dominoes, so kids can copy the visible spacing.
- L6/L11 (pop): fixed -30/+30 deg planks act as funnels under the spike shelf, so any reasonable fan placement in the lower half works; balloons slide along the plank undersides into the spikes.
- L7 bumper: pedestal bowl is offset ~130px right of the bumper; the berry arrives with ~140px/s rightward drift, so an energetic near-vertical bounce arcs into the bowl; the tall pedestal wall doubles as a backstop for its left rim.
- L8/L12/L14 seesaw: assumes the standard genre behavior that the launched light ball gets a mostly-vertical fling with a modest outward (away-from-pivot) horizontal component (~50-120px/s); bowls/bells are placed 50-90px outward from the berry's start to match. Marble impacts fall 240-400px onto the outer third of the arm.
- L12: the fence wall (x 267-303) is fully cleared at apex and the bowl rim (135-265) does not overlap it; without the conveyor the marble lands harmlessly on the floor, so the level cannot be shortcut.
- L4: the low wall at x=600 blocks the floor route, forcing the conveyor; the conveyor's drop point clears the wall by 150+px of height.
- L14 chain (fully spectator-friendly, ~6-8 seconds): beach ball rolls off the tilted ramp, crosses the player bridge-plank onto the big table, topples 6 dominoes (2 player-placed), the last domino nudges the marble off the table edge, the marble crashes onto the seesaw's near arm, and the berry is flung up-right into the bowl at x=1175 (rim tops out at x=1240, inside bounds).
- Sparkles in every level trace the intended ball flight so collecting all 3 confirms the canonical path during automated runs.
Suggested extra Lory barks for wins: "Squawk-tacular!", "That's using your beak!", "Berry good!", "My feathers are tingling!"
